title: 'New feedback' is counted three different ways, and the Needs you number does not match the list it opens
what: Needs you says 'N new feedback messages to read' and leaves out help questions waiting for a reply (they are counted on their own line). Its link opens the New feedback list, which shows every new message, help questions included, so the list is longer than the number. The gym list's new-feedback column and the System page's 'new' feedback count every new message again, help questions included. With 2 plain messages and 3 waiting help questions, Needs you says 2, the list shows 5, and the System page says 5.
expected: One rule for 'new feedback': the Needs you number matches the list its link opens, and the gym list and System page use the same rule or say they include help questions.
how_often: whenever a help question is still new
fix_line: Count new feedback with one rule everywhere, and open the list filtered to exactly what the number counts

title: A gym's 'Last 30 days' of AI use really adds up 31 days
what: The gym page says 'Last 30 days: N reads, about Rs X'. The server reads from the India day 30 days back up to today, which is 31 days. The check-ins on the same page call 30 days today and the 29 days before it. A read made exactly 30 days ago is counted in AI use, but a check-in on that same day is not.
expected: Both '30 days' numbers on the gym page cover the same 30 days.
fix_line: Start the AI window 29 days back, the same as check-ins

title: The System page's 'in all' feedback and lead totals shrink overnight with no reason shown
what: The System page shows feedback and leads as 'N new, M in all'. Every night the clean-up deletes feedback older than a year and leads older than a year that were not won. The 'in all' number then goes down although nothing was removed by hand, and the page never says these are only the last 12 months.
expected: The totals say they cover the last 12 months (or how many were cleared), so a lower number has a reason on screen.
how_often: from a year after launch, most nights
fix_line: Label the totals 'last 12 months' or show how many the clean-up removed

items.reason: Facts made in this area: new feedback, help waiting, leads, AI today and month, AI limit, check-ins, alert summary, usage alert. AI today and the gym's own limit both use the India day and the same row (consistent). Dues, plan end and birthdays are not worked out here (SQL in the database areas; the billing worker only passes them through). Crispy Curves SQL: 2 visits (1 in 7 days, 2 in 30), 0 unsent alerts, so edges are shown from code.
Usage week window, summary slot (daily and weekly, 8-day late rule) and backup 30-hour freshness hold at their edges; the AI 30-day window is one day too long. Crispy Curves: 0 future-dated visits.

The 'N new updates' summary push counts the same rows it marks sent, with the same visible and not-read rules as the bell; the gym page AI total is summed from its own day rows; System totals drop after the yearly clean-up with no reason.
The Needs you number (webNeeds count) and its list (listFeedback) are two functions with different rules; the AI month total and day rows share one query shape.
Long gap: an AI day row older than the window is left out of both total and rows alike; a weekly usage check that fails leaves the old alert for at most 7 days, then it goes (no wrong number shown).
